receipt_method: Commands, exit status and counts transcribed from completed tool execution outputs observed in this agent task. This JSON was prepared without rerunning the tests.
source_state_scope: Each receipt covers the working tree at its own execution time. Later concurrent edits are outside that receipt; the final aggregate validation is separate.

checks.name: storage_cache_and_offset_io
scope: Complete GGUF shards, metadata-only first shard and opening from a later shard
Malformed counts, offsets, overlaps, metadata and shard sets
Owned cache hard capacity, immutable lease identity, LRU and concurrent misses
Prefill hit-only policy and bounded complete-triplet warmup without PLE reads
Warmup failure atomicity and direct/buffered positional-read fallback
checks.receipt_note: Completed successful gate recorded in this agent execution transcript before later aggregate tests.

checks.name: all_supported_quantization_reference_parity
scope: All 14 native GGML formats: exact decoded-value comparison across 32 deterministic packed-pattern seeds
Scalar and selected SIMD dot products against the reference across eight seeds with unaligned storage
Malformed geometry and nonfinite scale rejection
checks.receipt_note: The compatibility engine is an integration-test oracle only; it is not a dependency of native inference.

checks.name: host_memory_accounting
scope: Actual Qwen3.8 PLE shape/type and exact lazy-versus-dense classification
Actual 48-layer geometry with 12 attention/indexer and 36 recurrent layers
One/four host-state slot reserves and resident-GPU host allowance
Automatic/explicit cache budgets, requested ceiling clamping and exhausted headroom
Checked metadata arithmetic, overflow, malformed recurrent metadata and context/slot bounds
checks.receipt_note: Final successful focused run followed correction of an unrelated concurrently edited protocol-test compilation error.

checks.name: protocol_literal_markup_and_reasoning
scope: JSON/XML function-call parsing and identity validation
Disabled tools preserve literal tool markup
Backtick/tilde fences and inline code preserve examples with active tools
Default thinking does not hide plain output; actual reasoning prefixes remain supported
Generation annotations, request validation and deterministic sampler finite-value gate
checks.receipt_note: This ten-test run predates the subsequently added official-template and tojson parity cases; those require their separate/final gate.

checkpoint_header_evidence.count_basis: Retained bounded header report, with the single lazy PLE tensor name/shape/type confirmed against the bounded descriptor extraction; other tensor count is total minus routed minus lazy.

limitations.gpu_shader_and_model_validation: Owned by separate Vulkan/Qwen gates; not represented by these four command receipts.
limitations.memory_plan: Estimate of available headroom and payload/state allowances; not an OS memory reservation or performance guarantee.
